General status of the White Rabbit Switch from the wrsGeneralStatusGroup. Elements are:
            wrsMainSystemStatus - Grouped status of WRS switch,
            wrsOSStatus - Grouped status of wrsOSStatusGroup
            wrsTimingStatus - Grouped status of wrsTimingStatusGroup,
            wrsNetworkingStatus - Grouped status of wrsNetworkingStatusGroup

Status of the timing system from the wrsTimingStatusGroup. Elements are:
            wrsPTPStatus - Grouped status of PTP daemon based on values in wrsPtpDataTable,
            wrsSoftPLLStatus - Grouped status of Soft PLL based on values in wrsSpllState,
            wrsSlaveLinksStatus - Grouped status of slave links,
            wrsPTPFramesFlowing - Grouped status of TX and RX PTP packets flowing,
            wrsSystemClockStatus - Grouped status of system clock

Status of the networking system from the wrsNetworkingStatusGroup. Elements are:
            wrsSFPsStatus - Grouped status of SFPs,
            wrsEndpointStatus - Grouped status of all endpoints,
            wrsSwcoreStatus - Overall status of Soft Core,
            wrsRTUStatus - RTU status
The software version, as returned from 'git describe' at build time
The hardware version, as returned from 'git describe' at build time
The current TAI time in seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00
The current TAI time as a string in format YYYY-MM-DD-HH:MM:SS
The system clock is compared to NTP time
Leap second status

Temperature readings from the White Rabbit Switch from the wrsTemperatureGroup. Elements are:
            wrsTempFPGA - FPGA temperature,
            wrsTempPLL - PLL temperature,
            wrsTempPSL - Power Supply Left (PSL) temperature,
            wrsTempPSR - Power Supply Right (PSR) temperature
